progress.summary: Closed the reporting layer of the outbound trust boundary and the third silent-empty schema drift. Added the route-level proof that executes the three handlers (no test in this domain had ever executed one), recovered a hard break the previous wave left (reportMissingSchemaOnce called at two sites, never declared: two TS2304 diagnostics and a ReferenceError waiting in a catch block, ungated because vitest does not typecheck), and found drift 3 was worse than recorded: the code reported it only from a catch, and PostgREST resolves an absent relation as { data: null, error } rather than throwing, so the report could never fire and error was destructured away. Both queries now read error, report once naming the table, the PostgREST code and the routing handoff, and degrade a 'preferences' signal that reaches the response and gates the timeline cache. Added lib/news/feed-service.ts to the working set: both drifted candidate queries and getUserPreferenceData live there and app/api/news/feed owns no query of its own, so no fix was possible from the route.
completed: Defined reportMissingSchemaOnce in lib/news/feed-service.ts. Before: two TS2304 diagnostics and a ReferenceError waiting in a catch block. After: 0 scoped diagnostics.
Made drift 3 detectable: getUserPreferenceData destructures error from both the user_news_preferences and user_news_subscriptions queries, reports each once, and degrades 'preferences'.

Added 'preferences' to NewsFeedDegradedSource and threaded onDegrade from buildNewsFeed through getUserSignalProfile to getUserPreferenceData, so the dead ranking signal reaches GET /api/news/feed meta.degradedSources.
Kept the timeline-cache gate: a feed whose personalization signal is dead is not promoted to a cache hit, same rule already applied to the section-level drifts.

Added 78-test route-level SSRF proof including the two destinations the existing suite did not name: explicit self-fetch (forged Host = the deployment's own hostname, unconfigured and configured) and redirect-into-private (302 with a 169.254.169.254 / 127.0.0.1 / 10.0.0.5 Location, plus a 301 at the opportunities ingest).
Added allowed-host-still-works proof covering both the news feed and the opportunities ingest in one test.

Added 4 behavioural tests for drift 3: names both tables in degradedSources and logs each exactly once; does not cache a timeline ranked without personalization; does not report a drift when the same tables answer; does not claim a drift for an anonymous reader who never queries them.

Added 2 structural guards to __tests__/news/news-feed-schema-drift.test.ts: both un-migrated tables must read error and must degrade, and reportMissingSchemaOnce must be declared in the module that calls it.
Recorded a caveat that the structural drift suite reads the live worktree and therefore passes against a pre-fix runtime, so only the behavioural suite is a valid pre-fix gate.

Pre-fix proof executed without touching the shared worktree: base-SHA sources extracted with git show into a mirror outside the workspace and aliased from a throwaway vitest config. 66 of 87 failed, 21 passed.
Updated docs/engineering/agents/discover/STATE.md with the durable facts, including the PostgREST-does-not-throw lesson and the structural-vs-behavioural guard distinction.
Defined reportMissingSchemaOnce; scoped type check went from 2 diagnostics to 0.
getUserPreferenceData now reads error on user_news_preferences and user_news_subscriptions, reports each once, and degrades 'preferences'.
Added 'preferences' to NewsFeedDegradedSource and threaded onDegrade from buildNewsFeed through getUserSignalProfile to getUserPreferenceData.
Added 78-test route-level SSRF proof including the two destinations the existing suites did not name: self-fetch and redirect-into-private.
Added 4 behavioural tests for drift 3 and 2 structural guards in news-feed-schema-drift.test.ts; 14 new tests total, 195 -> 209.
Pre-fix proof run without touching the shared worktree: base-SHA sources aliased from a mirror outside the workspace -> 66 of 87 assertions failed, 21 passed.

Database lane: regenerate lib/database.types.ts after that apply and reduce the 7-entry ACCEPTED list in __tests__/news/news-feed-schema-drift.test.ts, which this lane is read-only on and deliberately did not shrink.
